Armed Conflict & Security.title: First Thing: Oil prices surge as attacks on Saudi Arabia stoke supply fears
Armed Conflict & Security.text: Strike on kingdom’s east-west pipeline could affect 4% of global oil supply. Plus, report reveals British monarchy’s role in financing slave tradeGood morning. Oil prices have climbed above $108 a barrel after a series of drone attacks from Iraq’s territory forced Saudi Arabia to close its east-west crude pipeline. Saudi traders said the kingdom would run out of oil stocks for export if it did not reopen within days. Gas prices also climbed higher. Energy prices have surged this year, as the US-Israel war with Iran has disrupted oil and gas supply across the Middle East.The spike came as the Iran-aligned Houthi forces in Yemen launched several attacks against Saudi Arabia and captured the strategic island of Perim in the Bab al-Mandab strait on Sunday, expanding their control of the waterway.Where did the attack on Saudi Arabia come from? Iraq’s government confirmed the attacks were launched from its territory and ordered an investigation. Baghdad is under mounting pressure to stop militant groups – including those backed by Saudi Arabia’s regional rival Iran – launching attacks on Gulf countries from Iraqi soil. The US president, Donald Trump, said he believed Tehran was responsible.Why has Saudi Arabia been relying on its east-west pipeline? Riyadh has increased the use of the 745-mile pipeline since the start of the war on Iran in order to bypass the strait of Hormuz’s closure. The world’s biggest exporter has used the pipeline to reroute about 4m barrels a day – about 4% of global supply – but with the ‌pipeline out of service, the Red Sea port of Yanbu now has stocks to maintain exports for just five to seven days.What is the Anthropic CEO proposing? Robert Booth explains Amodei’s suggestion: first, each US AI company grants access to third-party evaluators; second, all companies in democratic countries establish common safety standards; and third, the world’s democratic AI powers coordinate with autocracies – notably China – to control the race.How has Barack Obama intervened over AI? The former US president made a direct appeal to Democrats to coalesce around a unified AI safety policy, arguing that waiting for voluntary compliance from tech firms was a recipe for governance failure. Sports.title: Kimi Antonelli Claims His Eighth Win of 2026 at the Inaugural Madrid Street Circuit Grand Prix
Sports.text: SummaryKimi Antonelli takes the inaugural victory at the Madring for his eighth win of the 2026 seasonA severely mistimed pit stop under the Virtual Safety Car strips pole-sitter Lando Norris of the leadMax Verstappen secures second place by utilizing the track's tight layout to block a recovering NorrisVictory at the inaugural Spanish Grand Prix went to Kimi Antonelli for his eighth win of the 2026 season. The result followed a race where track position dictated the podium because tight corners limited overtaking opportunities. This circuit layout increased the penalty for a poorly timed pit stop that affected pole-sitter Lando Norris. Such a narrow racing surface ensures that qualifying and strategy remain critical components of the weekend.Norris controlled the pace until a Virtual Safety Car (VSC) period began on lap 14. A car halted by Lance Stroll prompted the majority of the field to pit for fresh tires. McLaren called Norris to the box on lap 16 just as the VSC ended. A 7-second stop on lap 17 further delayed his return to the track. The sequence dropped Norris to fifth place behind George Russell.Charles Leclerc stayed out on old tires for the majority of the race. He led until lap 48 before a late stop resulted in a fourth-place finish. Max Verstappen capitalized on the shifting order after starting third to move into second. He used the layout of the Madring to block a recovering Norris. The Red Bull driver crossed the line in second for his fourth podium in five races. Norris recovered to finish third after starting from the lead.Lewis Hamilton retired on lap seven following a brake failure. He joined Aston Martin's Lance Stroll, Cadillac's Sergio Perez and Williams's Carlos Sainz as a retirement. Hamilton now trails Antonelli by 101 points in the championship standings. Russell finished fifth and sits 20 points ahead of Ferrari driver Hamilton. Economy & Markets.title: Apple Reportedly Planning Major Apple Store Renovations, Including the Return of the Dedicated Genius Bar
Economy & Markets.text: SummaryApple is accelerating retail renovations to prioritize traditional service, retail and fulfillment layoutsDedicated Genius Bars will replace the giant marketing video walls currently sitting at the back of locationsNew 10-foot Avenue bays will be installed to handle online pickups and Today at Apple sessionsApple is accelerating an overhaul of Apple Stores to prioritize traditional retail, direct service and efficient fulfillment. A report by Mark Gurman indicated that the company plans to increase the pace of renovations over the coming years. This shift revolves around three major architectural changes designed to rethink customer movement through the space. The strategy marks a departure from the open-concept Genius Grove layout that the company adopted more than a decade ago. By realigning the floor plan, the brand moves away from communal zones to focus on practical, dedicated service hubs.The most dramatic visual change occurs at the back of most Apple Stores where giant video walls will be removed. These displays currently host Today at Apple sessions and marketing materials, but renovated layouts replace them with dedicated Genius Bars. Reintroducing the iconic service desk reverses a decision to use tree-lined groves for support. This updated Genius Bar features an all-wood look resembling past service stations. To improve accessibility, the new installations incorporate two counter heights. Storage drawers and large printed posters highlighting products sit on the wall behind the new desks.Fulfillment zones and accessory displays also receive a redesign as the company revamps its Avenue sections. These areas occupy the sides of the stores where services and add-ons are traditionally promoted. Current pickup and workshop functions use large tables and seating areas that dominate the floor. Upcoming renovations migrate these experiences into 10-foot side sections known as bays. Two specific Avenue sections will be added for online pickups and Today at Apple sessions.The Avenue bay for online pickups consists entirely of wood and features an integrated logo. Secure drawers for customer orders sit in the lower portion of this bay. A standalone table stands ahead of the pickup bay to provide employees with space to manage the order handoff. Instructional zones for Today at Apple sessions in renovated Apple Stores feature a large display for presentations and built-in drawers for instructors to store devices.Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

Entertainment.title: TSTS's ‘The Wizard of Oz’ Tote Stacks Rhinestones Over a Printed Canvas Body
Entertainment.text: SummaryTSTS has produced a limited-run Wizard of Oz tote bag built on a canvas body finished with a special printRhinestones are layered over that print so the surface throws off the red shine of the film's magic shoesThe bag arrives alongside the brand's FW26 collection "The Saxe Blue Gingham," an official Wizard of Oz collaborationTSTS has made a Wizard of Oz tote bag, and the construction is more involved than the format suggests. The bag starts from a canvas body carrying a special print, then adds a second pass of rhinestones set over the printed surface, a stacking technique that gives the graphic physical relief rather than leaving it flat. The effect the brand is chasing is the red glint of the film's magic shoes.The tote is a special item produced for the occasion rather than a general release, and it is being made in limited numbers. It belongs to a wider Wizard of Oz collaboration series that TSTS has developed into "The Saxe Blue Gingham," the brand's FW26 collection, which puts the film's iconography into the label's own vocabulary.That vocabulary is gingham. The check is TSTS's brand signature, and pieces built on it are being carried alongside the collaboration items, which places the Oz material and the house pattern in the same room for the first time. The pairing also explains the collection's name, with the saxe blue reading as a color direction rather than a graphic one.The bag itself is the most technically involved piece in the mix. Canvas is a deliberately plain base, and the decision to print it first and then bead over the print means the shine sits proud of the fabric rather than being simulated in ink.The Wizard of Oz tote is available at the TSTS pop-up store, held in the 1F POP UP SPACE "GATE" at Shibuya PARCO from September 15 through September 23, and through the TSTS Online Store.Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

Entertainment.title: thisisneverthat x UNDERCOVER Rework the Apple Motif Into a Washed Denim Down Jacket
Entertainment.text: Summarythisisneverthat and UNDERCOVER have built a joint collection that reinterprets the apple motif and other artworks from UNDERCOVER's graphic archiveThe lineup is led by a washed denim down jacket and a jacquard zip-up hoodie, backed by denim pants and graphic T-shirtsA run of accessories rounds out the collaboration, which opens in Tokyo this week before reaching Seoul in Decemberthisisneverthat and UNDERCOVER have put together a collaborative collection, and the pieces are worth getting specific about. The Seoul label has taken UNDERCOVER's signature apple motif along with a broader set of artworks and run them through its own lens, rather than simply reprinting them at scale. The result covers outerwear, denim, jersey and accessories, with the heaviest construction saved for the top of the range.The anchor piece is a washed denim down jacket, a combination that asks the denim to carry a baffled insulated build while the wash treatment keeps the surface broken in rather than rigid. Sitting beside it is a jacquard zip-up hoodie, where the graphics are woven into the fabric structure itself instead of being applied on top, which is the more labor-intensive route to a motif and the one that holds up better over repeat wears.From there the collection works down through the wardrobe. Denim pants extend the material story from the jacket, graphic T-shirts carry the artwork in its most direct form, and a range of accessories completes the offering. Across all of it, the apple sits as the recurring device, reframed through thisisneverthat's own graphic sensibility.The thisisneverthat x UNDERCOVER collection drops Friday, September 18 at 5 p.m. JST, available exclusively at the thisisneverthat Shibuya Flagship. A pop-up follows at the thisisneverthat Seongsu Flagship in Seoul this December.Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

Entertainment.title: Apple Is Reportedly Working on Beats-Branded iPhone Game Controllers
Entertainment.text: SummaryApple develops two first-party game controllers for the iPhoneHardware launches under the Beats brand rather than the main Apple lineupLower price points and lifestyle branding target a wider gaming audienceApple is supposedly developing two first-party iPhone game controllers to expand its mobile hardware ecosystem. Joe Rossignol reported the discovery on September 13, after finding references in the macOS 26.7 operating system code. Mark Gurman later confirmed that the hardware targets iPhone users despite the discovery in Mac software. Internal code identifies these devices as first-party products.The tech giant plans to release the hardware under the Beats brand to reach a different market demographic. Beats executives lead the development process according to reporting by Gurman. This move follows recent brand expansions into lifestyle accessories like phone cases and charging cables.iPhone game controllers released under this banner allow for more aggressive pricing. Manufacturers avoid the high-end finishes and premium materials found on mainline Apple products to lower costs. Lower price points help the company target a broader audience of mobile gamers.Using the subsidiary as an incubator lets the parent company test new categories without risking its flagship luxury status. Gaming culture fits the Beats lifestyle image better than the minimalist aesthetic of standard Mac accessories. These iPhone game controllers establish a first-party presence in a market previously served by third-party peripheral manufacturers.Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

Longevity & Anti-Aging.text: Researchers have been working towards practical approaches to inhibiting RUNX2 activity as a way to slow age-related loss of bone mineral density. Bone extracellular matrix is constantly remodeled throughout life, created by osteoblast cells and destroyed by osteoclast cells. In youth these activities are balanced, but with advancing age osteoclast activity comes to dominate. Many drugs have been deployed in attempts to improve osteoblast activity or suppress osteoclast activity, but researchers continue to try to create incrementally better approaches. RUNX2 inhibition acts by increasing osteoblast activity. Here, a novel RUNX2 inhibitor emerging from the cancer research community is demonstrated to slow loss of bone mineral density in mice.
